name: Seeker reduces the mana cost of every Idol, including Cleansing and Spirit Link (#12674)
contract: Report #12674: the Witch Doctor talent Seeker (705880) reads 'Reduces the mana cost of your Wards, Idols, and
Effigies by 20%'. Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER / SPELLMOD_COST -20 with class mask (0x2000, 0, 0),
which covers the Serene, Dark, Jungle and Swift Idols, the Healing Ward and the Cursed Effigy but not the
Cleansing Idol 504840 (mask (0, 0x100000, 0)) or the Spirit Link Idol 706369 (mask (0x80, 0, 0)), whose costs
Seeker left unchanged. The mask now also carries 0x80 in word 0 and 0x100000 in word 1; the only other
family-19 spell with either bit is Spirit Eclipse 802717, which costs no mana. Expected: each idol costs 80% of
its cost before the talent (truncated to whole mana), the Serene Idol as the control that already worked.

steps.label: Spirit Link Idol cost before Seeker
SETUP: Spirit Link Idol costs mana
SETUP: the Seeker passive is active
